description:
End-to-end automated coverage.

1. Go test (scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog): pending-questions endpoint returns workshop questions sorted by priority ranking under multi-item fixtures; cover blocked-vs-unblocked ordering and --initiative filter.
2. Go test (scenarios/swarm-manager/cli): CLI wrapper forwards flags, filters by --source and --initiative, emits stable JSON for skill consumption.
3. Scenario test (test-genie or manual harness): seed swarm-manager with 3 backlog items across 2 initiatives, each with 2 open workshop decisions; run the workshop-decision-prep heartbeat; assert last-handoff.md shape, per-brief hash presence, early-return when cap is already met; mutate one decision's options and re-run, assert only that one brief is refreshed; call workshop/save for one decision directly (simulating UI answer) and re-run the skill's freshness step, assert the now-answered decision is dropped.
4. Skill smoke test: documented manual test plan invoking the skill with a fully staged handoff, confirming narrative grouping, focus-stack behavior under a mid-decision clarifying question, and async clarification spawn.
name: workshop-decision-sync-tests
title: Automated tests for pending-questions sort + prep specialist + sync skill
